name: cache-keepalive
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while background tasks run

compactOnCap.title: Compact when the ping budget runs out
compactOnCap.description: Compacts the conversation while the cache is still warm instead of letting it expire. Loses context detail.

vetoIdleCompaction.title: Veto idle compaction during a wait
vetoIdleCompaction.description: Keeps the full context while background work is pending. Heuristic: see the README.
